messages:
Marta: Heads-up — we saw a 3x bump in validation soft_rejects for fncall on customer-prod in eu-west this morning. Many of those requests got routed to the degen fallback and ate quota. anyone else seeing this?
Kevin: saw the spike too. logs show validator_score around 0.45-0.55 borderline. Routing policy currently treats <0.5 as hard reject -> degen. maybe thresh too strict for the new model?
Sarah: quick note — the billing logs only mark `route:degen` but don't surface `validation_score` or `rejection_reason`. hard to backfill why quota was charged.
Eli: agreed. we need a small schema change in the audit entry: add fields `validator_score` and `validation_mode` (soft|hard) so console can break down cost by reject type.
Marta: exactly. also telemetry: sample rate for validator metrics is 1% in prod. with that low sampling we missed the distribution shift.
Kevin: proposal: rollout soft-validate (no immediate degen) for 24h on 10% traffic, emit `validation_event` in audit logs, surface in dashboard. if urgent we can do 100% for the problematic model only.
Sarah: dashboard work: we need per-route time-series for "soft_reject_count", "hard_reject_count", plus histogram of validator_score. current console panels are per-model only.
Eli: quick patch: add two fields to s3/audit: `validator_score` (float), `validation_label` (soft/hard/none). Also add `route_decision` (primary/degenerate/fallback).
Kevin: minimal log change LGTM. we also should tag logs with `route_id` and `policy_version` for later bisection.
Marta: are we okay with GDPR/PII — nothing sensitive but check we don't add raw prompt text to audit. keep prompt redacted.
Sarah: yes redact. only include prompt_hash and truncated_prompt_length. include explicit schema in the PR template.
infra-bot: deploy request created: BUILD-4032 -> add audit fields to fncall-audit schema. link: https://ci.internal/builds/4032
Eli: for rollout UX: console should show a toggle to enable "soft-validate" and a sample slider (1%,10%,100%) per-env. UX note for PM: default to 10% for canary.
Marta: ops ask: when soft-validate hits threshold, we should auto-signal to routing to avoid mass quota consumption. maybe a circuit-breaker: if soft_reject_rate > 5% for 1m, throttle to 5%.
Kevin: ok. implement metrics alert: soft_reject_rate > 5% sustained -> alert on-call + auto-rollback flag for routing service.
Sarah: one more: billing pipeline needs mapping: if routed_to_degen but validation_label=soft then mark as "investigation_charge" not customer-visible charge until reconciled.
Eli: that mapping is a little complex for downstream billing. can we instead keep degen routing but credit back if validation_label=soft within 24h? create a billing-credit job.
Marta: sounds good. who will own console panel? @Sarah can you take the dashboard card and PR for the audit schema? timeline: have basic view in staging by EOD tomorrow?
Sarah: I'll pick it up. will open the dashboard PR and schema PR. tagging @Kevin for routing flags and @Eli for billing mapping.
Kevin: I'll add the policy_version and circuit-breaker changes. target: roll soft-validate 10% tomorrow morning.
Eli: I'll prototype billing-credit job and tests. will add a small spreadsheet for edge cases.
Marta: thanks all. next steps tracked in the ticket: INFRA-1029. keep notes in the ticket, not just here. :thumbsup:
Sarah: noted. I'll include example log lines in the PR description:

```
fncall_audit {
  request_id: "r123",
  model: "open-llama-70b",
  validator_score: 0.48,
  validation_label: "soft",
  route_decision: "degen",
  policy_version: "v2026-03-21-1"
}
```

Marta: perfect. closing the loop — let's meet sync at 10:15 if anyone wants to walk through telemetry changes.
Eli: i'll join. 
Kevin: joining. 
infra-bot: CI build queued: BUILD-4032 -> tests: audit_schema_integration, validator_metrics_sampling
